hero.headline: AI agents for music IP
hero.subhead: Debaser is the agentic operating system that values, grows, and manages music catalogues for publishers. Every song, split and territory traceable in one automated platform, for a new generation of catalogue owners investing in an equitable music industry.
hero.note: Built for independent publishers, catalogue funds and writers.

problem.headline: A trillion-dollar industry, still running on decades-old plumbing.

items.title: Inherit the songs and the mess
items.description: Years of statements, split sheets and sub-publishing deals arrive in a different shape from every source.

items.title: Nobody knows what the catalogue really earns.
items.description: Every report tells a different story. The value ends up a guess dressed as a model.

items.title: Money leaks quietly.
items.description: Unregistered songs, black-box royalties, expired deals. Income the songs earned that nobody collected.

items.title: The writers feel it first.
items.description: Late statements and wrong splits reach the people who wrote the songs long before they reach a spreadsheet.

productFlow.headline: One workspace, many agents, tasked to recover the value in music.
productFlow.subhead: Debaser sits above the old world of music royalty administration, keeping a living record of every song, split and payment. It follows the catalogue from the first listen to every statement you send, and each quarter it finds more of what the songs are owed.

steps.label: Ingest
steps.description: Bring in the seller's statements, contracts, split sheets and registrations, in any format.

steps.label: Understand
steps.description: Debaser maps every song, writer, split and territory into one clear picture.

steps.label: Value
steps.description: See what the catalogue really earns, how it's trending, and where it can grow.

steps.label: Diligence
steps.description: Unregistered songs, broken metadata, expired deals and split disputes, all surfaced before you buy.

steps.label: Grow
steps.description: After close, Debaser collects every royalty, pays each writer on time, and keeps finding income the songs were missing.

agents.headline: A specialist agent for every stage of a song's life.

items.name: Ingest Agent
items.description: Reads PRO statements, mechanical statements, sync deals, sub-publishing agreements and cue sheets the moment they land.

items.name: Understanding Agent
items.description: Turns writer and publisher splits, territories and collection chains into one clear picture of who owns each song.

items.name: Valuation Agent
items.description: Models what each song earns, how it's ageing, and how much more it could bring in.

items.name: Diligence Agent
items.description: Finds unregistered songs, missing ISWC or CWR data, expired deals and split disputes before you commit.

items.name: Royalty Agent
items.description: Calculates mechanical, performance and sync income, and pays every writer accurately and on time.

items.name: Growth Agent
items.description: Recovers unclaimed and black-box royalties, fixes metadata at the source, and chases the sync and re-registration income the songs are owed.

agents.note: Every agent works from the same record of the songs, before and after you own them.

missingMoney.headline: The same songs, earning more.
missingMoney.subhead: Debaser compares what a catalogue should earn against what it actually collects, then goes and closes the gap. Every quarter the songs bring in a little more, and every writer gets their share.
features: Songs that were never registered, filed properly.
Missing territories and societies, brought in.
Expired sub-publishing deals, renegotiated or replaced.
Splits corrected to match the paperwork.
Sync and licensing income the songs earned but nobody chased.
missingMoney.ctaLabel: See what a catalogue could earn

explainability.headline: Ask anything.
explainability.body1: Ask why a song's earnings moved, where the uncollected money sits, or which writer is owed what. Debaser traces every answer back to the statement row, the registration, the contract term.
explainability.body2: Not a summary. Not a guess. A clear answer with the evidence attached, whether it's for your investment committee or a writer's manager on the phone.
explainability.chatUserMessage: Why is this song earning less than last year?
explainability.chatAiResponse: Streaming is down 22% over three years, driven by two 2019 sync placements rolling off. The song itself is steady, not fading. It is also unregistered in Germany and France, so roughly £4,200 a year in performance income is going uncollected. Register it and that comes back, split with the co-writers as the agreement sets out.

trust.headline: Built for rights sensitive data.
trust.subhead: A catalogue's data passes between buyers, sellers, lawyers and lenders, and it holds every writer's income. Debaser treats all of it with the care it deserves.

vision.headline: A straight line - from every play to every rights holder.
vision.body1: Say goodbye to blanket contracts. The technology to connect every song with every revenue stream worldwide has arrived.
vision.body2: Starting with the operations layer, every catalogue the agents work on teaches the next one. Sharper valuations, better collection, and a fairer share reaching the people who wrote the songs.
vision.graphCaption: Songs → Recordings → Contracts → Income → Ownership → Usage

earlyAccess.headline: Bring us a catalogue you're serious about.
earlyAccess.body: We work with a small group of independent publishers, sub-publishers and catalogue funds. Share the seller's data and we'll hand back a full read on the songs, the earnings and the upside.

valueProps.title: A real catalogue, not a demo
valueProps.text: We take one live opportunity from your pipeline and run it end to end.

valueProps.title: Direct input into what we build
valueProps.text: The gaps you hit become the next thing on our roadmap.

valueProps.title: Founding customer terms
valueProps.text: Early partners keep their terms as we grow. That doesn't change later.
